name: Yeon-ho
source:
Belongs to Crobidoll's R-line. Yeon-ho had to go through two different owners before finally settling in at Eri's place. He is the shortest of all the guys when in human form, and his cute looks, brings out everyone's mother instinct. He can talk to animals and spirits.

He calls Eri "Master", and continually follows her around. He is referred to as "Chick" by Yuri and others at the academy.

[spoiler]In his route, he later becomes known as the "Phoenix" after Eri forces him to change, and he becomes more mature. [/spoiler]

Hobbies: Making fried eggs, studying cooking
Likes: Cookies, Master
Dislikes: Being left alone

[Edited From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
